purpose: 장면 10개 시작 키프레임 — 승인용 스토리보드이자 실제 클립의 시작 프레임(칸 나누지 않은 단독 이미지)

items.name: s01
items.prompt: Miniature diorama photograph, vertical 9:16. The whole scene is built as ONE square block diorama floating on a plain dark charcoal background, with its chunky wooden base edge clearly visible. Everything except the giant isopod is a deliberately rough, simple, hand-made scale model: chunky shapes, visible clay, wood and foam textures, like a tabletop model kit. Strong tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical lighting, muted grey-green and brown palette. Camera: high three-quarter angle looking down at the block. The giant isopod, when present, must match the attached replica and real reference images EXACTLY in anatomy and colour and be highly detailed: pale lavender-lilac glossy armour, arched body, overlapping segments, long thin antennae, thin legs tucked beneath, spiny fan-shaped tail plate, flat dark triangular compound eyes at the front corners of the head. Keep the upper quarter of the frame calm and uncluttered for captions. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no logos, no signs, no watermark, no collage, no split screen, no multiple panels, no border frames. SCENE: A rough 19th-century wooden fishing boat model sits on a small patch of glossy resin sea. Two tiny simple fisherman figures haul a dripping rope net over the side; inside the net a single giant isopod is visible. Overcast evening light.
